numbers.unit: glucose molecules s^-1 cell^-1 at 2 percent sucrose (58.4 mM)

numbers.name: closed_form_check
numbers.value: G = (1 - eps) h (N - N0)/gamma equals direct integration at 20 random sets (rel < 1e-8)

numbers.name: upper_estimate
numbers.value: glucose uptake before the switch lowers free glucose below the closed form at 20 random sets

note: Derivation with registered literature values (YEAST_SUCROSE_PARAMETERS); not a comparison with an outcome. Under C_L3_TRACE_FEEDBACK the shared glucose released by invertase is the trace; Dai et al.'s fitted switch density N_c = 276 cells/ul at gamma_low = 0.318/h and Koschwanez et al.'s invertase kinetics give G* = (1 - eps) h N_c/gamma_low = 1.56 mM, an upper estimate (uptake neglected; eps = 0.01 quoted from memory of Gore et al. 2009, 1 percent effect). Testable prediction: an independent measurement of yeast growth rate against glucose must show the rise from about 0.32 to 0.47 per hour near 1.6 mM or below. Needs a preregistered Test Card with a growth-versus-glucose dataset not used here. Nearest known theory: public-goods models of yeast cooperation and Allee effects. Not UET-distinct (the trace is set by enzyme kinetics, not by energy use).
